Container.Name: red-discordbot
Container.Overview:
The newest Red-Discordbot in a convenient multi-arch container.
How to create a bot account: https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/v1.0.1/discord.html#creating-a-bot-account
More variables for Red-DiscordBot can be found in the readme: https://github.com/PhasecoreX/docker-red-discordbot

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: The bot token you want Red-DiscordBot to use.

Config.Name: Prefix
Config.Description: The prefix you want Red-DiscordBot to use for commands.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Red-DiscordBot data will be stored here.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as.
